# Play — Bowstring

- SudokuPad: [Bowstring on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Bowstring on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Every rule is native: the bow is an f-puzzles `doublearrow`, the string a `betweenline`, the arrow an `arrow`, and the
clues are `xsum`s. The apps draw these in their own colours, so the bow will not be brown there. I have not opened the
links in a browser. If anything looks off, use `grid.svg` in this folder as the reference picture.

Bow (double arrow): r2c4–r3c3–r4c2–r5c2–r6c2–r7c3–r8c4. String (between line): r2c4–r3c4–r4c4–r5c4–r6c4–r7c4–r8c4.
Arrow: circle r5c4, shaft r5c5–r5c6–r5c7.

X-sums (position = total; r0 = above, r10 = below, c0 = left, c10 = right): r4c10 = 44; r10c1 = 5; r5c10 = 12; r0c1 = 29; r3c0 = 32; r0c8 = 19; r10c6 = 30; r9c10 = 19; r6c10 = 24.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
